newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kohl expects good result at Amsterdam EU summit.
newsitem.headline: Kohl expects good result at Amsterdam EU summit.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl on Wednesday said he was convinced a good result would be reached when European Union leaders meet in Amsterdam for their June 16-17 summit.
Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok, meeting Kohl in Bonn, said he was sure Europe would take a big step forward at the meeting.
"I want to thank you dear Wim for the enormous work you have put into this," Kohl said during a brief statement while standing in front of photographers at the chancellery.
"I am confident...that we will have a good result at the meeting in Amsterdam."
Kohl said that the German government would do all it could to bring Europe a step forward.
Kok, speaking in German, said in his brief statement that he appreciated "Helmut's support" on European integration during the last six months while the Netherlands held the European presidency.
"We are almost finished," Kok said. "I am confident we can bring Europe a big step forward. We are building a new Europe, brick by brick."
The two men left to begin their meeting without taking any questions.
